parts.label: a
hints: Count the total number of letters and the frequency of each repeated letter in CHEESE.
CHEESE has 6 letters in total with the letter E appearing 3 times, so divide 6! by 3!.

walkthrough.text:
Count the total number of letters and identify repeats in CHEESE:
$$\text{Total letters } n = 6, \quad \text{Letter E appears 3 times}$$

Apply the repeated letters permutation formula:
$$\text{Total arrangements} = \frac{6!}{3!} = \frac{720}{6} = 120$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Identify the letter frequencies: C appears once, H appears once, E appears three times, and S appears once:
$$\text{Frequencies}: \quad 1 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 6$$

Divide by the factorial of the repeated group size to remove duplicate orderings:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{6!}{3!} = 120$$

ai_rubric.observable: Apply the repeated letters permutation formula 6! / 3!.

parts.label: a
hints: Count the letters in COFFEE: there are 6 letters with 2 Fs and 2 Es.
Divide 6! by the product of the factorials of both repeat sizes: 2! and 2!.

walkthrough.text:
List the letter frequencies for the 6-letter word COFFEE:
$$\text{Total letters } n = 6, \quad \text{Frequencies: 1 C, 1 O, 2 Fs, 2 Es}$$

Compute distinct arrangements using the multinomial division formula:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{6!}{2! \times 2!} = \frac{720}{2 \times 2} = \frac{720}{4} = 180$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Observe that swapping the two Fs or swapping the two Es leaves the visible word unchanged:
$$\text{Repeated groups: two Fs and two Es}$$

Divide the total factorial by 2! for each pair of duplicates:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{6!}{2! \times 2!} = 180$$

ai_rubric.observable: Apply the repeated letters formula dividing by 2! * 2!: 6! / (2! * 2!).

parts.label: a
hints: Fix the letter B at the first position. There is only 1 way to place B at the start.
Count permutations of the remaining 5 letters: A, A, A, N, N.

walkthrough.text:
Fix the letter B at the first position. The remaining 5 positions are filled by the letters $\{\text{A, A, A, N, N}\}$:
$$\text{First position: B (1 choice)}, \quad \text{Remaining pool: 3 As, 2 Ns}$$

Calculate permutations of the 5 remaining letters with repeats:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{5!}{3! \times 2!} = \frac{120}{6 \times 2} = \frac{120}{12} = 10$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Place the required letter B in the leading slot first:
$$\text{Word structure}: \quad \text{B} \; [\text{5 remaining slots}]$$

Permute the multiset of five remaining letters containing three As and two Ns:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{5!}{3! \times 2!} = 10$$

ai_rubric.observable: Fix B at the start and arrange the remaining 5 letters with 3 As and 2 Ns: 5! / (3! * 2!).

parts.label: a
hints: Count total digits: 7 digits with two 2s and three 3s.
Divide 7! by (2! * 3!).

walkthrough.text:
Identify the total count and multiplicities of the digits $2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 5, 7$:
$$n = 7, \quad \text{Multiplicities: two 2s, three 3s, one 5, one 7}$$

Apply the repeated items permutation formula:
$$\text{Total numbers} = \frac{7!}{2! \times 3!} = \frac{5040}{2 \times 6} = \frac{5040}{12} = 420$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Notice that all 7 digits are non-zero, so every arrangement yields a valid 7-digit number:
$$\text{Total digits} = 7, \quad \text{Repeats: } 2! \text{ and } 3!$$

Evaluate the factorial quotient:
$$\text{Distinct 7-digit numbers} = \frac{7!}{2! \times 3!} = 420$$

ai_rubric.observable: Apply the multiset permutation formula 7! / (2! * 3!) for two 2s and three 3s.

parts.label: a
hints: PARALLEL has 8 letters: 1 P, 2 As, 1 R, 3 Ls, 1 E.
Fix one L at the front and one L at the back, leaving 6 letters to arrange in the middle.

walkthrough.text:
Fix the letter L at both ends. PARALLEL has 3 Ls, so 1 L remains for the interior:
$$\text{Format}: \quad \text{L} \; [\dots 6 \text{ interior letters} \dots] \; \text{L}$$

The 6 interior letters are $\{\text{P, A, A, R, L, E}\}$, which has two As:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{6!}{2!} = \frac{720}{2} = 360$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Set up the fixed boundaries using two of the three available Ls:
$$\text{Ends fixed}: \quad \text{L} \dots \text{L}$$

Count arrangements of the remaining six letters where only A is repeated twice:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{6!}{2!} = 360$$

ai_rubric.observable: Fix L at both ends and arrange the remaining 6 letters with two As: 6! / 2!.

parts.label: a
hints: Arrange the other 3 distinct letters (A, L, E) first, which creates 4 gaps.
Choose 2 of the 4 gaps to insert the two identical letters P.

walkthrough.text:
Arrange the 3 letters other than P (A, L, E):
$$\text{Arrangements of A, L, E} = 3! = 6$$

These 3 letters create 4 gaps. Choose 2 distinct gaps for the two identical Ps:
$$\text{Gap choices} = \binom{4}{2} = 6, \quad \text{Total} = 6 \times 6 = 36$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Apply the gap method by first arranging the three distinct letters A, L, E:
$$\text{Arrangements} = 3! = 6$$

Place the two identical Ps into two of the four available gaps so that no two Ps are adjacent:
$$\text{Total} = 3! \times \binom{4}{2} = 6 \times 6 = 36$$

ai_rubric.observable: Use the gap method 3! * 4C2 or complement method (5! / 2!) - 4!.

parts.label: a
hints: Count the letters in TOMATO: there are 6 letters with 2 Ts and 2 Os.
Divide 6! by (2! * 2!).

walkthrough.text:
Count the letters and repetitions in TOMATO:
$$n = 6, \quad 2\text{ Ts}, \; 2\text{ Os}, \; 1\text{ M}, \; 1\text{ A}$$

Calculate the total number of distinct arrangements:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{6!}{2! \times 2!} = \frac{720}{4} = 180$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Identify repeat multiplicities: T occurs twice and O occurs twice:
$$\text{Denominator} = 2! \times 2! = 4$$

Divide the factorial of the word length by the product of duplicate factorials:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{6!}{4} = 180$$

parts.label: b
hints: Place T at the first position. There is only 1 way to do this.
Arrange the remaining 5 letters: 1 T, 2 Os, 1 M, 1 A.

walkthrough.text:
Fix one T at the start. The remaining letters to arrange are $\{\text{T, O, O, M, A}\}$:
$$\text{Remaining letters } = 5, \quad \text{with 2 Os}$$

Calculate the arrangements of the remaining 5 letters:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{5!}{2!} = \frac{120}{2} = 60$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Lock T in the initial slot, leaving five letters to permute:
$$\text{Pool}: \quad \{\text{T, O, O, M, A}\}$$

Divide 5! by 2! for the two identical Os:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{5!}{2!} = 60$$

ai_rubric.observable: Fix T at the start and arrange the remaining 5 letters with two Os: 5! / 2!.

parts.label: a
hints: ARRANGE has 7 letters with 2 As and 2 Rs.
Divide 7! by (2! * 2!).

walkthrough.text:
Count the letters in ARRANGE:
$$n = 7, \quad \text{Repeats: 2 As, 2 Rs, 1 N, 1 G, 1 E}$$

Calculate the number of distinct permutations:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{7!}{2! \times 2!} = \frac{5040}{4} = 1260$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Count letter frequencies across the 7 positions in ARRANGE:
$$\text{Frequencies}: \quad 2\text{ As}, \; 2\text{ Rs}, \; 1\text{ N}, \; 1\text{ G}, \; 1\text{ E}$$

Divide by the duplicate counts to obtain the unrestricted total:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{7!}{2! \times 2!} = 1260$$

parts.label: b
hints: Only letters that appear at least twice can occupy both the first and last positions.
The only repeated letters are A and R. Calculate arrangements beginning and ending with A, then with R, and add.

walkthrough.text:
Identify which letters can occupy both ends: only A and R appear twice:
$$\text{Matching end letters} \in \{\text{A, R}\}$$

Calculate arrangements for each case:
$$\text{Ends A: arrange remaining } \{\text{R, R, N, G, E}\} \implies \frac{5!}{2!} = 60$$
$$\text{Ends R: arrange remaining } \{\text{A, A, N, G, E}\} \implies \frac{5!}{2!} = 60$$

Sum the two disjoint cases:
$$\text{Total} = 60 + 60 = 120$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Determine the candidates for identical endpoints from the repeated letter set:
$$\text{Candidate letters} = \{\text{A, R}\}$$

Evaluate each disjoint endpoint scenario:
$$\text{A} \dots \text{A}: \frac{5!}{2!} = 60, \quad \text{R} \dots \text{R}: \frac{5!}{2!} = 60$$

Combine the mutually exclusive counts:
$$\text{Total} = 60 + 60 = 120$$

ai_rubric.observable: Identify the two possible matching end letters as A and R.
Evaluate each case as 5! / 2! = 60 and sum: 60 + 60.

parts.label: a
hints: Count the letters in COLLEGE: 7 letters with 2 Ls and 2 Es.
Apply the standard multinomial formula: 7! / (2! * 2!).
Evaluate 5040 / 4 to obtain the result.

walkthrough.text:
List letter counts in COLLEGE:
$$n = 7, \quad 1\text{ C}, \; 1\text{ O}, \; 2\text{ Ls}, \; 2\text{ Es}, \; 1\text{ G}$$

Divide by the factorials of the repeat sizes:
$$\text{Total arrangements} = \frac{7!}{2! \times 2!} = \frac{5040}{4} = 1260$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Identify repeat multiplicities in the 7-letter word COLLEGE:
$$\text{Repeated}: \quad 2\text{ Ls and } 2\text{ Es}$$

Calculate the unrestricted arrangement count:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{7!}{2! \times 2!} = 1260$$

ai_rubric.observable: Calculate total arrangements of COLLEGE as 7! / (2! * 2!).

parts.label: b
hints: Treat the two letters L as a single block: [LL].
Because the two Ls are identical, there is only 1 internal arrangement for [LL].
Arrange the 6 units: [LL], C, O, E, E, G, taking care of the 2 identical Es.

walkthrough.text:
Treat the two identical Ls as a single block [LL]. There is only 1 way to order [LL]:
$$\text{Units to arrange}: \quad [\text{LL}], \; \text{C}, \; \text{O}, \; \text{E}, \; \text{E}, \; \text{G} \implies 6 \text{ units}$$

Among these 6 units, the letter E appears twice:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{6!}{2!} = \frac{720}{2} = 360$$

Multiply by internal arrangements (which is 1):
$$\text{Total} = 360 \times 1 = 360$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Bind the two Ls into one composite item [LL]. Identical letters inside a block have no distinct permutations:
$$\text{Internal arrangements of } [\text{LL}] = 1$$

Count permutations of the six resulting entities, dividing by 2! for the two identical Es:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{6!}{2!} = 360$$

Confirm the final answer:
$$\text{Total} = 360$$

ai_rubric.observable: Treat LL as a single block with 1 internal arrangement.
Arrange the 6 units with two identical Es as 6! / 2!.

parts.label: a
hints: DIVIDED has 7 letters: 3 Ds, 2 Is, 1 V, 1 E.
Fix one D at the first position and one D at the last position.
Count arrangements of the remaining 5 letters: 1 D, 2 Is, 1 V, 1 E.

walkthrough.text:
Fix D at both the start and end of the word:
$$\text{Word template}: \quad \text{D} \; [\dots 5 \text{ letters} \dots] \; \text{D}$$

The remaining 5 letters are $\{\text{D, I, I, V, E}\}$, containing two identical Is:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{5!}{2!} = \frac{120}{2} = 60$$

Conclude the number of arrangements:
$$\text{Total} = 60$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Lock two of the three Ds in the boundary slots:
$$\text{Ends fixed}: \quad \text{D} \dots \text{D}$$

Arrange the interior pool of five letters having two identical Is:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{5!}{2!} = 60$$

Record the result:
$$\text{Total} = 60$$

ai_rubric.observable: Arrange the remaining 5 letters with two identical Is as 5! / 2!.

parts.label: b
hints: Use the gap method: arrange the other 5 letters (D, D, D, V, E) first.
Account for the 3 identical Ds when arranging those 5 letters: 5! / 3! = 20.
Five arranged letters create 6 gaps. Choose 2 gaps for the two identical Is: 6C2.

walkthrough.text:
Arrange the 5 letters other than I: three Ds, one V, and one E:
$$\text{Arrangements of } \{\text{D, D, D, V, E}\} = \frac{5!}{3!} = \frac{120}{6} = 20$$

These 5 letters create 6 available gaps. Select 2 distinct gaps for the two identical Is:
$$\text{Ways to choose gaps} = \binom{6}{2} = \frac{6 \times 5}{2 \times 1} = 15$$

Multiply arrangements of other letters by gap selections:
$$\text{Total arrangements with Is separated} = 20 \times 15 = 300$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Permute the letters that are not subject to the separation condition:
$$\text{Arrangements of D, D, D, V, E} = \frac{5!}{3!} = 20$$

Select two gaps from the six available gaps around the five arranged letters:
$$\binom{6}{2} = 15$$

Multiply the two stages together:
$$\text{Total} = 20 \times 15 = 300$$

ai_rubric.observable: Arrange the 5 other letters with 3 Ds as 5! / 3! = 20.
Choose 2 gaps from 6 available gaps as 6C2 = 15 and multiply: 20 * 15.

parts.label: a
hints: Count the total digits: 8 digits with multiplicities 2, 3, 1, 2.
The repeats are two 1s, three 2s, and two 4s.

walkthrough.text:
Identify total digits and repetition counts for $1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4$:
$$n = 8, \quad \text{Multiplicities: two 1s, three 2s, one 3, two 4s}$$

Set up the multinomial quotient:
$$\text{Total numbers} = \frac{8!}{2! \times 3! \times 2!} = \frac{40320}{2 \times 6 \times 2} = \frac{40320}{24}$$

Evaluate the quotient:
$$\text{Total} = 1680$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Note that no digit is 0, so every permutation forms an 8-digit number:
$$\text{Repeat factors} = 2! \times 3! \times 2! = 24$$

Apply the multiset permutation formula:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{8!}{24} = 1680$$

State the final count:
$$\text{Total} = 1680$$

ai_rubric.observable: State the multinomial formula with 8! in the numerator.

parts.label: b
hints: An even number must end in 2 or 4.
Case 1: Ends in 2. The remaining 7 digits have two 1s, two 2s, one 3, two 4s.
Case 2: Ends in 4. The remaining 7 digits have two 1s, three 2s, one 3, one 4.
Calculate both cases and add the counts.

walkthrough.text:
Partition into two mutually exclusive cases based on the last digit:
$$\text{Case 1: ends in 2}, \quad \text{Case 2: ends in 4}$$

Calculate the permutations for each case:
$$\text{Case 1 (ends in 2)}: \frac{7!}{2! \times 2! \times 2!} = \frac{5040}{8} = 630$$
$$\text{Case 2 (ends in 4)}: \frac{7!}{2! \times 3! \times 1!} = \frac{5040}{12} = 420$$

Sum the disjoint cases:
$$\text{Total even numbers} = 630 + 420 = 1050$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Apply the even parity condition at the units position, which requires 2 or 4:
$$\text{Last digit} \in \{2, 4\}$$

Calculate the remaining 7 digits for each ending digit choice:
$$\text{Ends in 2}: \frac{7!}{2! 2! 2!} = 630, \quad \text{Ends in 4}: \frac{7!}{2! 3!} = 420$$

Add the two disjoint results:
$$\text{Total} = 630 + 420 = 1050$$

ai_rubric.observable: Split into mutually exclusive cases ending in 2 and ending in 4.
Sum both cases to obtain 1050 even numbers.

parts.label: a
hints: ASSESSMENT has 10 letters.
Count frequencies: 1 A, 4 Ss, 2 Es, 1 M, 1 N, 1 T.
Divide 10! by (4! * 2!).
Evaluate 3628800 / 48.

walkthrough.text:
Count letter frequencies in ASSESSMENT:
$$n = 10, \quad 1\text{ A}, \; 4\text{ Ss}, \; 2\text{ Es}, \; 1\text{ M}, \; 1\text{ N}, \; 1\text{ T}$$

Calculate the total distinct permutations:
$$\text{Total arrangements} = \frac{10!}{4! \times 2!} = \frac{3628800}{24 \times 2} = \frac{3628800}{48} = 75600$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Identify repeat groups: S occurs 4 times and E occurs twice:
$$\text{Denominator} = 4! \times 2! = 48$$

Evaluate the factorial quotient:
$$\text{Total} = \frac{10!}{48} = 75600$$

ai_rubric.observable: Calculate total arrangements of ASSESSMENT as 10! / (4! * 2!).

parts.label: b
hints: Fix A at the start. There are 9 letters remaining: 4 Ss, 2 Es, 1 M, 1 N, 1 T.
Consonants that can end the word are S, M, N, and T.
Notice S is repeated 4 times, while M, N, T appear once each. Split into two cases: ending in S, or ending in M, N, or T.
Alternatively, count all arrangements starting with A and subtract those starting with A and ending in a vowel (E).

walkthrough.text:
Fix A at the start. Total arrangements of the 9 remaining letters (4 Ss, 2 Es, 1 M, 1 N, 1 T) starting with A are:
$$\text{Total starting with A} = \frac{9!}{4! \times 2!} = \frac{362880}{48} = 7560$$

Subtract those that end with a vowel. The only remaining vowels are the two Es. If A is first and E is last, the 8 remaining letters are 4 Ss, 1 E, 1 M, 1 N, 1 T:
$$\text{Arrangements with A...E} = \frac{8!}{4!} = \frac{40320}{24} = 1680$$

Subtract to find arrangements starting with A and ending in a consonant:
$$\text{Required arrangements} = 7560 - 1680 = 5880$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Fix the initial position with letter A:
$$\text{Arrangements starting with A} = \frac{9!}{4! \times 2!} = 7560$$

Calculate the complement condition where the word ends in a vowel (E):
$$\text{A} \dots \text{E} = \frac{8!}{4!} = 1680$$

Deduct the vowel-ending arrangements from the total:
$$\text{Total ending in consonant} = 7560 - 1680 = 5880$$

ai_rubric.observable: Recognize that words begin with A and end with a consonant, splitting by consonant or using complement.
Calculate arrangements ending in S (3360) and ending in M, N, or T (2520), or 7560 - 1680.

parts.label: c
hints: Treat all four letters S as a single block: [SSSS].
Because the four Ss are identical, there is only 1 internal arrangement for [SSSS].
Count the distinct arrangements of the 7 units: [SSSS], A, E, E, M, N, T.
Divide by 2! for the two identical Es.

walkthrough.text:
Treat the four identical Ss as one block [SSSS]. Since the Ss are identical, there is only 1 internal order:
$$\text{Internal arrangements} = 1$$

Arrange the 7 units: [SSSS], A, E, E, M, N, T, which includes two identical Es:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{7!}{2!} = \frac{5040}{2} = 2520$$

Multiply by internal arrangements:
$$\text{Total} = 2520 \times 1 = 2520$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Bundle all four Ss into one composite entity [SSSS]:

Calculate permutations of these seven items with two identical Es:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{7!}{2!} = 2520$$

Confirm the result:
$$\text{Total} = 2520$$

ai_rubric.observable: Treat the four Ss as a single block with 1 internal arrangement.
Arrange the 7 units with two identical Es as 7! / 2!.

parts.label: a
hints: Count letter frequencies in EXCELLENCE: 10 letters in total.
Repeats are: 4 Es, 2 Cs, 2 Ls, 1 X, 1 N.
Evaluate 3628800 / 96.

walkthrough.text:

$$n = 10, \quad 4\text{ Es}, \; 2\text{ Cs}, \; 2\text{ Ls}, \; 1\text{ X}, \; 1\text{ N}$$

$$\text{Denominator} = 4! \times 2! \times 2! = 24 \times 2 \times 2 = 96$$

Evaluate the quotient:
$$\text{Total arrangements} = \frac{10!}{96} = \frac{3628800}{96} = 37800$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:

$$\text{Repeats}: \quad 4\text{ Es}, \; 2\text{ Cs}, \; 2\text{ Ls}$$

Divide the full factorial by the factorial of each duplicate group:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{10!}{4! \times 2! \times 2!} = \frac{3628800}{96}$$

Record the unrestricted total:
$$\text{Total} = 37800$$

ai_rubric.observable: State the multinomial formula with 10! in the numerator.

parts.label: b
hints: Fix an E at the beginning and an E at the end.
Two Es have been placed, leaving 2 Es, 2 Cs, 2 Ls, 1 X, 1 N to arrange in the 8 middle slots.
Evaluate 40320 / 8.

walkthrough.text:
Fix E at both ends of the word:
$$\text{Word structure}: \quad \text{E} \; [\dots 8 \text{ middle letters} \dots] \; \text{E}$$

The remaining 8 letters have 2 Es, 2 Cs, 2 Ls, 1 X, 1 N:

Conclude the number of arrangements:

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Place two of the four identical Es in the terminal positions:
$$\text{Ends fixed}: \quad \text{E} \dots \text{E}$$

Count permutations of the interior eight letters containing three pairs of duplicate letters:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{8!}{2! \times 2! \times 2!} = 5040$$

State the final count:
$$\text{Total} = 5040$$

ai_rubric.observable: Arrange the remaining 8 letters with two Es, two Cs, and two Ls: 8! / (2! * 2! * 2!).

parts.label: c
hints: Use the gap method to keep the 4 identical Es separated.
First arrange the other 6 letters (C, C, L, L, X, N), taking care of repeats: 6! / (2! * 2!).
These 6 letters create 7 gaps. Choose 4 gaps for the four identical Es: 7C4.
Multiply the arrangements of the other letters by the gap combinations: 180 * 35.

walkthrough.text:
Arrange the 6 letters other than E: two Cs, two Ls, one X, and one N:
$$\text{Arrangements of non-E letters} = \frac{6!}{2! \times 2!} = \frac{720}{4} = 180$$

$$\text{Ways to choose gaps} = \binom{7}{4} = \frac{7 \times 6 \times 5 \times 4}{4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1} = 35$$

Multiply arrangements of other letters by gap selections:
$$\text{Total arrangements with no two Es adjacent} = 180 \times 35 = 6300$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Permute the six letters that are not Es, dividing by 2! for the two Cs and 2! for the two Ls:
$$\text{Arrangements} = \frac{6!}{2! \times 2!} = 180$$

Select four distinct gaps from the seven available gaps around the six arranged consonants:
$$\binom{7}{4} = 35$$

Multiply the independent stages:
$$\text{Total} = 180 \times 35 = 6300$$

ai_rubric.observable: Arrange the other 6 letters (two Cs, two Ls, X, N) as 6! / (2! * 2!) = 180.
Choose 4 distinct gaps from 7 available gaps as 7C4 = 35 and multiply: 180 * 35.
